assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for BRINE, a top-down underwater industrial pixel-art station builder. Carefully rendered chunky pixel-art forms with selective fine detail, muted deep-ocean palette, soft upper-left ambient light, no sunlight beams. Orthographic overhead camera, no horizon, no isometric diamond. No text, labels, UI, border, station structures, characters, bright glow or fantasy crystals. One square edge-to-edge ground material for Sulfur vent basin. Dark charcoal volcanic grit with muted ochre sulfur stains, small anhydrite chips, fine warm-grey mineral sediment and broad quiet black sand areas. No active vents or lava. Flat low-relief background under brighter station rooms, low contrast. Natural irregular distribution with no central focal subject. Fill all pixels to every edge with sediment, fully opaque, no transparent margins. Designed for repeated terrain use, avoid conspicuous features at edges. 1536 square.
